The <b>{{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a grave decoration which provides +3 {{Grave Decor}} when placed on a [[gravesite]], after a [[corpse]] has been buried there. Installing or uninstalling any grave decoration costs {{Energy|5}}. Excess stone decor may be recycled at a [[Stone cutter II|stone cutter]], generating ~50% of its materials. For more information, see [[graveyard]].
